{"name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset","version":"1.0","description":"Reads, searches, edits, and compiles the Verse source of the open Verse Project. File tools act on
.verse files addressed by their Verse path (e.g. `/<project>/Sub/Foo.verse`). That root is project-
specific -- it is not `/Game` -- so pass `""` to address the root itself, and build paths from the ones
the listing and search tools return. Read-only verse digests are accessible through `/<VRI> (Name)`.","tools":[{"description":"Create, overwrite, or edit a region of a .verse file.","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.WriteFile","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string","description":"Path to a .verse file."},"content":{"type":"string","description":"Text to write; empty deletes the target region (or empties the file). No separator is inserted around the written region, so include a leading "\n" when starting a new line."},"span":{"description":"What to write. Unset overwrites the whole file. A span replaces that region of an existing file; a zero-width span inserts without replacing (an end-of-file span therefore appends).","default":null,"title":"VerseToolsetSourceSpan","type":"object","properties":{"startLine":{"type":"integer","default":0},"startCharacter":{"type":"integer","default":0},"endLine":{"type":"integer","default":0},"endCharacter":{"type":"integer","default":0}}},"bCreateIfMissing":{"type":"boolean","description":"Create the file (and parent directories) when it does not exist. Applies to a whole-file write or an end-of-file append, not to a region replace."}},"required":["path","content","bCreateIfMissing"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Replace OldString with NewString in a .verse file.","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.Replace","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string","description":"Path to a .verse file."},"oldString":{"type":"string","description":"Existing text to find."},"newString":{"type":"string","description":"Replacement text. Must differ from OldString."},"bReplaceAll":{"type":"boolean","description":"Replace every occurrence. When false, OldString must occur exactly once.","default":false}},"required":["path","oldString","newString"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"integer","description":"Number of occurrences replaced."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Read a .verse file.","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.ReadFile","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string","description":"Path to a .verse file."},"span":{"description":"Region to read. Unset reads the whole file. Out-of-range positions are clamped.","default":null,"title":"VerseToolsetSourceSpan","type":"object","properties":{"startLine":{"type":"integer","default":0},"startCharacter":{"type":"integer","default":0},"endLine":{"type":"integer","default":0},"endCharacter":{"type":"integer","default":0}}}},"required":["path"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"The file's text, or the text within Span when one is given."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Move/rename a .verse file, or a directory whose subtree contains only .verse files.","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.Move","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sourcePath":{"type":"string","description":"Source path. A file source (and its dest) must be a .verse file; a directory source's subtree must contain no non-.verse file."},"destPath":{"type":"string","description":"Destination; must not already exist; parent must exist; may not be inside a directory source."}},"required":["sourcePath","destPath"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"List a directory's .verse files and subdirectories (other files are omitted).","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.ListFiles","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string","description":"Directory path to list. An empty path ("") lists the project's own top-level Verse package plus the read-only generated digest packages it depends on, each as a directory entry."},"bRecursive":{"type":"boolean","description":"Descend into subdirectories."}},"required":["path","bRecursive"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"array","items":{"title":"VerseToolsetFileEntry","type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","description":"The entry's path.","default":""},"type":{"type":"string","title":"EVerseToolsetFileEntryType","enum":["File","Directory"],"description":"File or directory.","default":"File"}}},"description":"The directory's .verse files and subdirectories."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Search .verse files for a pattern.","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.Grep","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"pattern":{"type":"string","description":"Text to find, within a single line; a line break is rejected."},"bRegex":{"type":"boolean","description":"Match Pattern as a regular expression, not a literal substring."},"bCaseSensitive":{"type":"boolean","description":"Match letter case exactly."},"pathGlob":{"type":"string","description":"Glob restricting which files are searched ("" = every .verse file ListFiles can reach). '*' and '?' match within a single path segment; a '**' segment matches across directories. A bare "*" will not match anything as there are no top-level files; lead with a '**' segment to match .verse files at any depth."},"maxResults":{"description":"Maximum matches to return; unset means unlimited.","default":null,"type":"integer"}},"required":["pattern","bRegex","bCaseSensitive","pathGlob"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"array","items":{"title":"VerseToolsetGrepMatch","type":"object","properties":{"filePath":{"type":"string","description":"Path to the file the match was found in.","default":""},"span":{"title":"VerseToolsetSourceSpan","description":"Span of the matched substring. Matches are single-line, so StartLine == EndLine and the span
is [StartCharacter, EndCharacter) on that line.","default":{"startLine":0,"startCharacter":0,"endLine":0,"endCharacter":0},"type":"object","properties":{"startLine":{"type":"integer","default":0},"startCharacter":{"type":"integer","default":0},"endLine":{"type":"integer","default":0},"endCharacter":{"type":"integer","default":0}}},"lineText":{"type":"string","description":"Full text of the matching line.","default":""}}},"description":"One match per matching line, in file then line order."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Render a directory's .verse files as a compact tree. Other files, and subdirectories with no .verse file
anywhere beneath them, are omitted. Path's entries are unindented and their contents indented beneath them;
files come before subdirectories, and a directory holding a single entry shares its line, joined by '/'.","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.FileTree","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string","description":"Directory path to render. An empty path ("") renders every top-level package, as ListFiles does; each package is labeled by its full path (and listed even when it holds no .verse file), every other entry by its name alone."},"maxDepth":{"description":"Maximum number of levels below Path to render (1 = immediate children only); unset means unlimited.","default":null,"type":"integer"}},"required":["path"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"The tree, with directories suffixed by '/', then the directory and file counts."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"read"}},{"description":"Delete a .verse file, or a directory whose subtree contains only .verse files.","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.Delete","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string","description":"Path to delete. A file path must be a .verse file; a directory's subtree must contain no non-.verse file. The workspace root is rejected."},"bRecursive":{"type":"boolean","description":"Delete a non-empty directory recursively."}},"required":["path","bRecursive"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Create a directory, including any missing parent directories.","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.CreateDirectory","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string","description":"Directory path to create."}},"required":["path"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Copy a .verse file, or a directory whose subtree contains only .verse files.","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.Copy","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"sourcePath":{"type":"string","description":"Source path. A file source (and its dest) must be a .verse file; a directory source's subtree must contain no non-.verse file."},"destPath":{"type":"string","description":"Destination; must not already exist; parent must exist; may not be inside a directory source."},"bRecursive":{"type":"boolean","description":"Required (true) when the source is a directory."}},"required":["sourcePath","destPath","bRecursive"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"write"}},{"description":"Compile all Verse code in the project.","name":"VerseToolset.VerseToolset.BuildAll","inputSchema":{"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"array","items":{"title":"VerseToolsetDiagnostic","type":"object","properties":{"severity":{"type":"string","title":"EVerseToolsetDiagnosticSeverity","enum":["Error","Warning","Information","Hint"],"description":"Severity of the diagnostic.","default":"Error"},"code":{"type":"integer","description":"Diagnostic reference code; 0 when none.","default":0},"message":{"type":"string","description":"Human-readable message.","default":""},"filePath":{"type":"string","description":"Path to the file the diagnostic refers too, as a virtual Verse path (a compiler path outside the project is reported as-is).","default":""},"span":{"title":"VerseToolsetSourceSpan","description":"Source span of the diagnostic within FilePath.","default":{"startLine":0,"startCharacter":0,"endLine":0,"endCharacter":0},"type":"object","properties":{"startLine":{"type":"integer","default":0},"startCharacter":{"type":"integer","default":0},"endLine":{"type":"integer","default":0},"endCharacter":{"type":"integer","default":0}}}}},"description":"Diagnostics produced by the build; no Error-severity entry means the build succeeded."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}}]}
